patthana23.7:1.1: dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo dassanena pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi,
patthana23.7:2.1: na kusalaṃ na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā akusalo bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.7:3.1: na kusalaṃ na neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato neva dassanena na bhāvanāya pahātabbo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. na kusalaṃ na dassanena
